prompt:
Create a new KFB claymation ink blob monster sheet for The Circle With One Extra Chair, Group therapy and psychiatric care. Supplied original images are style references for soft full continuous charcoal-plum ink blob shapes and handcrafted props. Six individually distinct complete upright footless blobs in three columns and two rows, landscape 1536x1024, true transparent PNG. Equal substantial scale, generous clear transparent gutters and margins, all props inside the cell and attached or held. Thick rounded goo bodies, short ink hands, distinct facial shapes and expressions, ivory white sclera, red iris and black pupil, filled modeled eyelids, teeth behind lips. Large soft modeling marks, gentle satin plasticine with very sparse fine grain, broad fabric folds, clear glass and smooth plastic. Keep dominant ink bodies and period or symbolic accessories small. No copied wings, eyepatches or reference costumes. No floor, scene, text, labels, shadows, frame, branding, graphic distress or caricature of illness. Gentle surreal satire of habits, theory and bureaucracy. Color and craft direction: Warm teal, soft sage, quiet gray and ochre, plain comfortable wraps. Row-major cast:
1. Female-read attentive group facilitator. small egg timer and open palm gesture. broad upright splat, patient gaze, attentive small smile.
2. Male-read eager participant learning to wait. simple padded talking token pressed to belly. springy tall bean, upturned wide eyes and closed eager smile.
3. Male-read hesitant newcomer. small folded note held between two goo hands. narrow tucked-in pear, eyes peeking sideways, trembling lip.
4. Female-read determined boundary setter. short soft knitted ribbon stretched just in front of body. low wide blob, eyebrows set, calm firm mouth.
5. Male-read weary listener who has found a quiet moment. tiny plain tea mug with a simple smooth handle. broad slumped bean, half lids and relief smile.
6. Male-read earnest intake administrator. thick plain clipboard with large blank checkboxes. square offset splat, worried gaze and tight mouth.
Exactly six unique freestanding cutouts. Make the main motif of each slot legible at small sizes.
